panel.name: CYP11B2 Selectivity Sentinel MVP

target.sequence_note: Mapped CYP11B2 catalytic-domain sequence from PDB 4FDH.

off_target_panel.why_screened: The principal selectivity liability for aldosterone-synthase inhibitors.
Important steroidogenic off-target to add after the B1/B2 gate.
Potential endocrine off-target; needs its own validated structure/protocol.
Relevant heme-P450 counter-screen, not a substitute for a broader safety panel.

policy.policy_note: A configurable engineering triage threshold, not a clinical safety boundary or universal medicinal-chemistry standard.

limitations: The target sequence and panel are deliberately declared and curated in this MVP; sequence-only genome-wide off-target discovery is future work.
Heme coordination, protonation, membrane environment, and electronic state require target-specific review.
No prospective prediction can establish binding, safety, or clinical selectivity without experimental counterscreens.

target.sequence_note: Mapped CYP11B2 catalytic-domain sequence from PDB 4FDH.

mandatory_primary_off_target.why_screened: The principal selectivity liability for aldosterone-synthase inhibitors.

cards.decision_scope: Retrospective paired-assay validation; this does not establish prospective model accuracy.

execution.warning: Native affinity files are present after a successful raw prediction log, but the execution wrapper did not finalize its manifest. Re-run or reconcile before promoting these to a formal benchmark.

boltz.interpretation: Positive target_advantage_log10 means the target has lower predicted IC50 than the declared off-target. This is a within-model ranking signal, not an experimental selectivity measurement.

model_screen.reason: Predicted target margin is below the model-screening policy; counter-screen required.

uma_local_chemistry.interpretation: UMA exchange is a local capped-pocket potential-energy stress test. It is not a binding affinity, free energy, or whole-proteome off-target score.

diagnostic.interpretation: Candidate coordination distances only; no calibrated acceptance thresholds.

boltz_geometry.interpretation: Geometry diagnostics check identity/chirality where possible; no distance cutoff establishes valid heme coordination.

paired_assay_validation.interpretation: Paired same-source inhibition reference; endpoint must not be mixed with another assay type.
